memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past month my hands have been swollen and stiff, especially in the mornings. I struggle to button my shirts and feel tired after housework. I’ve been taking my medicines as prescribed but the pain is worsening. I would like something stronger to control the inflammation.\n

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports swollen MCP and PIP joints, morning stiffness >60 minutes, difficulty with fine tasks; ADLs require occasional assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated; prior score 4/5 remains negative.
falls: no falls in last 12 months; gait mildly antalgic; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (raised fall risk). Plan: supervised balance exercises, supportive footwear.
medicines: 4 regular.
mood: expresses worry about worsening disease, denies depression.
carers: sister Priya, relationship: sister.
goal: "I want to reduce pain and swelling to resume teaching and gardening."\n

hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily

sulfasalazine 500 mg oral twice daily\n
